title: BBC Philip Marlowe
paragraphs: BBC Radio dramatizations of Raymond Chandler's Philip Marlowe novels, with Ed Bishop portraying the hard-boiled Los Angeles private detective in the original BBC adaptation cycle.

BBC Radio 4 Classic Chandler season adapting all seven completed Philip Marlowe novels plus posthumous Poodle Springs, starring Toby Stephens. Frozen eight-object set exactly matches the 2011 cycle; embedded metadata on all eight files says 2011.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Classic Chandler winter block (February 5, 2011 to February 26, 2011) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]] and Classic Chandler autumn block (October 1, 2011 to October 22, 2011) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Toby Stephens (performer), Claire Grove (director and producer), Robin Brooks (radio adaptor), Stephen Wyatt (radio adaptor), Mary Peate (director), and Sasha Yevtushenko (director).
The stories often return to hardboiled detective fiction, Los Angeles crime and corruption, Philip Marlowe, Raymond Chandler adaptation, and BBC Radio 4 drama.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Radio 4 Classic Chandler complete cycle, Posthumous completion of Poodle Springs, and First BBC all-novel Marlowe cycle including Playback and Poodle Springs.
